svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.16.1 Required Roof Sheathing
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure less than 0.8 kPa (16.7 psf)
seismic spectral acceleration, Sa(0.2), less than or equal to 0.70
Only where both apply does this Article not require continuous roof sheathing.

svg.text: Except where the 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure
is less than 0.8 kPa and the seismic spectral
acceleration, Sa(0.2), is less than or equal
to 0.70, continuous lumber or panel-type roof
sheathing is installed to support the roofing.
Drawn: part of a roof slope, roofing cut back. As printed: "1-in-50 hourly wind pressure". Sizes are illustration only.
